description: This file defines classes and functions for interacting with Microsoft Outlook API, including calendar, event, and message management tools, with dynamic tool creation based on specified actions.

classes.name: BaseOutlookTool
classes.description: Base class for Outlook tools, providing request handling and email parsing functionalities.

classes.name: ListCalendarsTool
classes.description: Tool for listing Outlook calendars.

classes.name: GetCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving a specific Outlook calendar.

classes.name: CreateCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool for creating a new Outlook calendar.

classes.name: UpdateCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool for updating an existing Outlook calendar.

classes.name: DeleteCalendarTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting an Outlook calendar.

classes.name: ListEventsTool
classes.description: Tool for listing events in Outlook calendars.

classes.name: GetEventTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving a specific Outlook event.

classes.name: CreateEventTool
classes.description: Tool for creating a new Outlook event.

classes.name: UpdateEventTool
classes.description: Tool for updating an Outlook event.

classes.name: DeleteEventTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting an Outlook event.

classes.name: ListMessagesTool
classes.description: Tool for listing Outlook mailbox messages.

classes.name: GetMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving a specific message.

classes.name: CreateDraftMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for creating draft messages.

classes.name: SendMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for sending messages.

classes.name: UpdateMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for updating message properties.

classes.name: DeleteMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting messages.

classes.name: CopyMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for copying messages to another folder.

classes.name: MoveMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for moving messages to another folder.

classes.name: ReplyMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for replying to messages.

classes.name: ForwardMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for forwarding messages.

methods.name: makeGraphRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the Microsoft Graph API with authorization.

methods.name: parseEmailAddresses
methods.description: Parses comma-separated email addresses into Graph API recipient objects.
